lines.text: Dark-clothed warriors scatter through the stormy sky as a giant white dragon roars, setting the stage for a brutal mid-air collision.
From the back of a massive dark beast, a masked figure shouts at the falling combatant, demanding they explain their intentions before attacking.
lines.quote: HEY! DON'T JUST GO SLICING WITHOUT SAYING ANYTHING!

lines.text: The confrontation ends in an instant as a blade tip stops inches from the long-haired figure's face, leaving them stunned by the sudden proximity.
